messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tell your healthcare provider if you are breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed while taking this medicine.
This medicine passes into breast milk.
There have been reports of seizures in breastfed infants.
Talk to your healthcare provider about the best way to feed your baby during treatment with this medicine.
Triplet: ["Bupropion", "passes into", "breast milk"]

The relation 'passes into' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is transferred or present in the biological fluid or substance specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'has use indication': The subject drug may be used for the medical purpose or indication specified by the object entity.
C. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'administered via': The subject drug is given through the route of administration specified by the object entity.
E. 'are being treated with': The subject entity is receiving treatment with the substance or therapy specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
